opening.text: I've come in because I have pain that came on slowly. It feels tender and burning, and I'd rate it a 5 out of 10. I've also been coughing up blood and I have a fever. My nose is either stuffy or I have a clear runny nose. I smoke cigarettes, and in the past two weeks I've been around someone with similar symptoms. I also go to or work in a daycare.
